features-grid[title]: Real, everyday tasks, handled by simply asking
features-grid[desc]: No coding. Nothing to install on your site. Tell an AI assistant what you want done, in your own words.

features-grid[data][desc]: Write a post about our new product launch and put it under News. Done in seconds.
One AI conversation manages all your Joomla sites. Nothing extra to install on any of them.
The AI can only do what your own Joomla user account is allowed to do.
Revoke the access key any time, just like changing a password. Access is cut off instantly.
Anything that really matters gets a check-in with you before it happens.
The connection lives in the cloud. Your Joomla website itself is never modified.
